entry_item.definition: [= ørgy-] v . t. a) To raise, lift up. b) To offer, present; to offer as a sacrifice. c) To adopt a child; to nurse. d) To extol; to show respect.

example.definition: A second name or style adopted by a person (Ch. tzû).
To elevate words above the margin (beginning a new line, as was done in formal letters and reports as a token of respect ).
To throw the opponent by lifting him at the armpits (in wrestling).
To raise the hand, vote by raising hands
To raise one's glass and toast someone 's health
To present; to offer as a sacrifice.
To offer an oath or vow.
To propose a spouse ( to a prince)
T. bsnyen bkur; S. upasana, paryu-pasana. To serve, honor, respect.

entry_item.definition: To lift up, to raise. To elevate. To lift up (the head). To exalt, to praise. To present, to give an offering.
